units.name: Fulgrim
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Fulgrim.

Army rules: Combat Drugs, Sublime Strategist.

Core: Deep Strike, Deadly Demise D6.

Keywords: Monster, Mobile, Fly, Character, Epic Hero, Daemon, Chaos, Slaanesh, Primarch, Fulgrim, Emperor's Children. Supreme Commander: must be your Warlord.

Malefic lash: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Blades - strike: [SUSTAINED HITS 2]. Blades - sweep: [CLEAVE 2], [SUSTAINED HITS 2]. Serpentine tail: [EXTRA ATTACKS].

**The Phoenician Prince**

While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls and add 1 to its Wound rolls.

**Master of Excess**

Before the battle, select two different Warband Elixirs for Fulgrim. Their normal effects are always active for him without dosage tests. When he becomes Stupefied, he retains both, gains both Stupefied effects, and also gains the normal and Stupefied effects of a third accessible Combat Elixir. The third choice is not restricted to Warband Elixirs.

**Sovereign of Sensation**

While Stupefied, Fulgrim is not Battle-shocked and cannot become Battle-shocked. He still takes required Leadership and Battle-shock tests and applies other consequences; the automatic-failure rule still applies except at recovery. He cannot take new doses. His Stupefied state ends at the normal next Command-phase recovery even though he is not Battle-shocked.

**Weapon ability: Daemonic Poisons - Serpentine tail**

After resolving attacks made with this weapon, each enemy unit that suffered damage from one or more of those attacks becomes Poisoned until the end of your opponent's next turn. While a unit is Poisoned, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons equipped by its models, to a minimum of 1. Apply this only after saving throws and rules that prevent wounds have been resolved. This effect does not stack with itself; a subsequent application refreshes its duration.

EPIC HERO / ABILITIES

Fulgrim / Continued

**Signature Elixir: Phoenician Ambrosia**

**Once per battle. Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until the end of**

that phase. Fulgrim's daemonic blade attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. If Stupefied, once during this activation, when he fights, he can make attacks with both the strike and sweep profiles of his daemonic blades. Resolve the tail only once; this is not another fight activation and grants no additional Pile-in or Consolidation.

**Ordinary doses while lucid**

While not Stupefied, Fulgrim can take multiple different additional ordinary Combat Elixirs using their normal timing and dosage Leadership tests, beyond his two permanent Master of Excess selections. While Stupefied, he cannot take new ordinary doses.

units.name: Lucius the Eternal
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Lucius the Eternal.

Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Core: Leader, Lone Operative, Feel No Pain 4+. Leader: Flawless Blades, Phoenix Guard Terminators.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Epic Hero, Chaos, Slaanesh, Lucius the Eternal, Emperor's Children.

Blade of the Laer: [PRECISION]. Lash of Torment: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. It does not have Extra Attacks; choose a melee weapon normally unless a rule explicitly grants otherwise.

**A Challenge Worthy of Skill**

Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Character, Monster or Walker unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

**Duellist's Hubris**

At the start of the Fight phase, if this model is not leading a unit, it has Fights First until the end of the phase.

**Signature Elixir: Duellist's Ichor**

Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until the end of that phase. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If Stupefied, their melee attacks also score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. Reusable.

**Signature Elixir: The Perfect Moment**

Once per battle. Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until its end. Lucius's melee weapons have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]. If Stupefied, once in that phase, after his unit has resolved its melee attacks, Lucius can make one additional set of melee attacks. Only Lucius attacks again; no additional Pile-in, Consolidation or bodyguard attacks are granted.

**Leader**

Flawless Blades, Phoenix Guard Terminators.

EPIC HERO / ABILITIES

Lucius the Eternal / Continued

**The Eternal**

Once per turn, during the Shooting or Fight phase, when Lucius is destroyed by an attack made by an enemy unit, the controller of that attacking unit must select one non-Epic Hero Infantry model from that attacking unit, if one exists. Place an ETERNAL marker on that model. At the start of each Fight phase, roll one D6 for the marked model. On a 3+, remove the marker, destroy that model and return Lucius to the battlefield in its former position with D6 wounds remaining. If his base cannot fit exactly, place him as close as possible. He can be set up within Engagement Range of the host's former unit or other enemy units. Lucius returns as a separate single-model unit and is Stupefied and Battle-shocked. Select one Combat Elixir from this codex for his unit, including Signature, Warband, detachment and enhancement elixirs. It gains the normal and Stupefied effects for that state. This does not refresh an expended once-per-battle use. If the host dies before possession resolves, that marker is lost and does not revive Lucius. If the attacking unit contains no eligible host, no marker is placed. Remove the marker before destroying a successfully possessed host so its destruction does not cancel that successful return.

**A Moment of Lucidity**

Once per battle, at the start of a phase, Lucius's unit can ignore Stupefied until the end of the current turn and immediately cease to be Battle-shocked. This explicitly overrides the normal restriction. During that interval, its selected elixir's normal effect continues, its Stupefied benefit and penalties are suspended, and it can take new doses normally. At the end of that turn, it becomes Stupefied and Battle-shocked again; other elixirs end and the original selected elixir's Stupefied effect resumes. This does not spend a new activation, refresh a once-per-battle use or extend the original next Command-phase recovery.

units.name: Eidolon
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Eidolon.

Army rules: Combat Drugs, Sublime Strategist.

Core: Leader, Deep Strike, Feel No Pain 5+.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Epic Hero, Jump Pack, Fly, Chaos, Slaanesh, Eidolon, Emperor's Children.

Death Scream: [TORRENT], [BLAST 2], [IGNORES COVER]. Glory Aeterna: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

**Lord Commander Primus**

Once per turn, when another friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 6" activates an otherwise legal Combat Elixir, it can do so without taking the dosage Leadership test.

**Auric Hammer**

While Eidolon is leading a unit, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee weapons have [LANCE] until the end of the turn.

**Master of the Eternal Song**

After this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made with its Death Scream. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

**Leader**

Infractors, Flawless Blades, Rapture Talons.

**Signature Elixir: Kakophonic Distillate**

Activate at the start of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase; lasts until the end of that phase. Death Scream has Devastating Wounds. If Stupefied, each time this model's unit is selected to fight, after its Pile-in move and before making its melee attacks, this model can make normal shooting attacks with Death Scream, targeting one enemy unit engaged with its unit. For those attacks, Death Scream loses Blast and has +2 Attacks, for 8 attacks. These attacks can target that engaged unit.

**Leader**

Infractors, Flawless Blades, Rapture Talons.

units.name: Ramos
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Ramos.

Army rules: Combat Drugs, Sublime Strategist.

Core: Leader. Leader: Noise Marines, Excruciator Terminators, Dissonant Colossi.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Epic Hero, Chaos, Slaanesh, Ramos, Emperor's Children.

Focused: [BLAST 2], [IGNORES COVER]. Saturation: [BLAST 2], [IGNORES COVER]. Select one Refrain profile when shooting.

**Conductor of the Eighth**

While Ramos is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

**Bull of the Eighth**

While Ramos is leading a unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of attacks allocated to models in that unit, to a minimum of 1.

**Signature Elixir: Deathless Chorus**

Activate at the start of either Shooting phase; lasts until the end of that phase. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have Lethal Hits. If Stupefied, each time a model in this unit is destroyed by an enemy ranged attack, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield until the attacking unit has resolved its attacks. The destroyed model can then make normal shooting attacks with its ranged weapons, after which it is removed. Each model can shoot this way only once per phase.

**Leader**

Noise Marines, Excruciator Terminators, Dissonant Colossi.

units.name: Julius Kaesoron
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Julius Kaesoron.

Army rules: Bound Excess, Sublime Strategist.

Core: Deep Strike. Keywords: Monster, Character, Epic Hero, Daemon, Chaos, Slaanesh, Julius Kaesoron, Emperor's Children. Julius does not consume Combat Elixirs or become Stupefied.

Warpfire: [IGNORES COVER]. Favoured blade: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Talons: [EXTRA ATTACKS].

**Exquisite Cruelty (Aura)**

While a friendly Emperor's Children unit is within 6" of Julius, add 1 to Wound rolls for its melee attacks that target Battle-shocked units.

**Favoured Son**

At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of Julius. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

**Gifts of the Favoured Son**

At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 6" of Julius that is neither Battle-shocked nor Stupefied. Select one Warband Elixir for that unit. Its normal effect is active until the end of the turn, ignoring its usual activation phase and without a dosage Leadership test.

units.name: Doomrider
units.rules:
Composition: 1 Doomrider.

Army rules: Bound Excess.

Core: Deep Strike. Keywords: Mounted, Fly, Character, Epic Hero, Daemon, Chaos, Slaanesh, Doomrider, Emperor's Children. Doomrider does not consume Combat Elixirs or become Stupefied.

Both meltagun profiles: [MELTA 3], [TWIN-LINKED]. Hunter can target only Monster or Vehicle units. Hellblade: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Wheels: [EXTRA ATTACKS].

**Ride Them Down**

After Doomrider ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range. Roll six D6; each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit.

**Here for the Sensation**

At the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can put it into Strategic Reserves.

**Hunting the Broken**

In your Movement phase, when this unit makes an ingress move using Deep Strike, it can be set up more than 6" horizontally from enemy Battle-shocked units, but must be more than 8" horizontally from every other enemy unit. This reduced distance does not apply when using Rapid Ingress.

**Revel in Slaughter**

When an enemy unit is destroyed by Doomrider's attacks or Ride Them Down, friendly Emperor's Children units within 6" can invoke Pain Brings Clarity. This does not clear Battle-shock while Stupefied.

units.name: Shalaxi Helbane
units.rules:
Core: Damaged 7, Deadly Demise D6. Army rules: Manifestation. Psyker Level: 2.

Composition: 1 Shalaxi Helbane. Equipment: Lash of Slaanesh, Pavane of Slaanesh, Soulpiercer, Snapping claws.

**Equipment options**

No options. Select one Pavane profile when shooting.

**Monarch of the Hunt**

At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit as this model's quarry. Re-roll melee Hit and Wound rolls against its quarry. When its quarry is destroyed, immediately select another enemy unit as its quarry. Becoming Debound does not change the selected quarry.

**No Prey Can Evade**

Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

**The Hunt Sustains**

At the end of each phase in your turn, if this model is within Engagement Range of its quarry, it does not lose a point through the Manifestation army rule.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Greater Daemonic Ritual; sacrifice required. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 6. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

Keywords: Monster, Character, Epic Hero, Chaos, Daemon, Summoned, Slaanesh, Shalaxi Helbane, Greater Daemon, Psyker. Faction: Legions of Excess.

EPIC HERO / LEGIONS OF EXCESS / ABILITIES

Shalaxi Helbane / Continued

**Reality Unravels - 12 inch Aura**

While a unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1; otherwise, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1. This affects friendly and enemy units alike. Multiple instances of Reality Unravels do not stack.

**The Hunting Ground - 6 inch Aura**

Whenever any other unit within 6" of this model is selected to Fall Back, it must first take a Battle-shock test. If it fails, it cannot Fall Back that phase. This affects friendly and enemy units, including Daemons.

**Inescapable Obsession (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of your Charge phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, until the end of the phase, this model can declare a charge even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn, provided its quarry is a target of that charge.

**Terror of the Hunt (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, if its quarry is visible and within 18", that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Manifestation gains use the normal triggers and caps.

units.name: The Masque of Slaanesh
units.rules:
Core: Fights First, Lone Operative. Army rules: Manifestation.

Composition: 1 The Masque of Slaanesh. Equipment: Serrated claws.

**The Eternal Dance**

At the start of either Fight phase, select one enemy unit within 6". Until the end of the phase, friendly Legions of Excess and Emperor's Children models add 1 to melee Wound rolls against that unit, and models in that enemy unit subtract 1 from their melee Wound rolls.

**Dazzling Acrobatics**

This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

**The Final Bow**

When this model becomes Debound, immediately before removing it, select one enemy unit within 6". That unit must take a Battle-shock test. Other nearby daemons can gain Manifestation normally. Remove the Masque afterward; this ability does not prevent its Debinding.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Lesser Daemonic Ritual. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Epic Hero, Fly, Chaos, Daemon, Summoned, Slaanesh, The Masque of Slaanesh. Faction: Legions of Excess.

rolls against that unit, and models in that enemy unit subtract 1 from their melee Wound
rolls.

This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

When this model becomes Debound, immediately before removing it, select one enemy unit
within 6". That unit must take a Battle-shock test. Other nearby daemons can gain
Manifestation normally. Remove the Masque afterward; this ability does not prevent its
Debinding.

Lesser Daemonic Ritual. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 at the end of every
phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

**Leader**

Infractors, Tormentors.

Core: Leader. Psyker Level: 1. Leader: Tormentors, Infractors, Noise Marines.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Psyker, Chaos, Slaanesh, Raptureweaver, Emperor's Children.

Both Blissfire profiles: [PSYCHIC], [TORRENT], [BLAST 1], [IGNORES COVER]. Focused also has [HAZARDOUS]. Mirrorstave: [PSYCHIC].

**Veil of Ecstasy (Psychic Level 1)**

When an enemy unit selects this unit as a target of its attacks, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

**Through the Looking Glass (Psychic Level 1)**

Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not Battle-shocked and is unengaged, you can make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

**Signature Elixir: Prismatic Nectar**

Activate at the start of your Movement phase; lasts until the end of the turn. When this unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, add 6" to models' Move characteristic for that Advance. If Stupefied, models in this unit can also move through other models when making Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves. They cannot end overlapping another model or within Engagement Range of enemy models.

**Leader**

Tormentors, Infractors, Noise Marines.

Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Core: Leader. Psyker Level: 2. Leader: Tormentors, Noise Marines, Flawless Blades.

Both Soulspike profiles: [PSYCHIC], [PRECISION]. Focused also has [HAZARDOUS]. Agonist's blade: [PSYCHIC], [PRECISION].

**An Audience of Suffering**

While this model is leading a unit, that unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]. While targeting a Battle-shocked unit, those attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

**Signature Elixir: Tyrant's Tears**

Activate at the start of your Shooting phase; lasts until the end of the phase. Soulspike gains [IGNORES COVER]. If Stupefied, its attacks also have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

**Leader**

Tormentors, Noise Marines, Flawless Blades.

CHARACTER / ABILITIES

Torment Oracle / Continued

**Visions of Abasement (Psychic Level 1)**

In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model, then make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

**Nerves Unstrung (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model, then make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, until the end of that turn, subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from its Charge rolls.

**Pavane of Submission (Psychic Level 2)**

In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy Infantry unit within 12" of and visible to this model that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army. Make a psychic roll by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, your opponent must make a Normal move of up to 6" with the selected enemy unit towards this model, ending as close to this model as possible. Models must maintain coherency and cannot move within Engagement Range of units from your army.

units.rules:
Composition: 1 Idol of Sublime Perfection.

Army rules: Bound Excess.

Core: Deadly Demise D3.

Keywords: Monster, Character, Daemon, Chaos, Slaanesh, Idol of Sublime Perfection, Emperor's Children.

**Overflowing Vitality (Aura)**

At the start of your Command phase, each friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" of this model heals D3 wounds. Roll separately for each unit.

**Fed by Suffering**

At the end of either player's turn, if one or more friendly units within 6" of this model invoked Pain Brings Clarity that turn, this model heals D3 wounds.

**An Impossible Beauty**

In your Shooting phase, select one enemy Infantry unit within 12" of and visible to this model that is not engaged with any units from your army. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If failed, your opponent must make a Normal move of up to D6" with it, ending as close to this model as possible, maintaining coherency and remaining outside Engagement Range of units from your army.

CHARACTER / ABILITIES

Idol of Sublime Perfection / Continued

**Communion of Excess**

At the end of your Command phase, this model can release Nectar of the Idol. Every friendly Emperor's Children unit excluding Daemons within 6" of this model becomes Stupefied, selecting Nectar of the Idol as its active Combat Elixir instead of another elixir. Do not take dosage Leadership tests for these activations. All other elixir effects end as normal for Stupefied. Units already Stupefied replace their selected elixir with Nectar of the Idol. The usual Stupefied penalties and next Command-phase recovery apply. The effect remains if a recipient subsequently leaves the Idol's range.

**Signature Elixir: Nectar of the Idol**

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. If Stupefied, those weapons also gain [CLEAVE 2]. Communion affects every friendly non-Daemon EC unit within range; it is not restricted to Infantry and does not select only one recipient. It is a voluntary release by the Idol, but once released all eligible units in its radius are affected. The Idol dispenses the drug. It does not gain Nectar's benefits itself. Its healing aura and self-heal remain separate abilities and do not require Nectar to be released.

**Bound daemonic body**

This model has the Daemon keyword and remains an Emperor's Children unit. It does not have Combat Drugs and cannot take dosages itself. Its two permanent Warband Elixir effects come only from Bound Excess. Communion of Excess administers Nectar to nearby eligible units; it is not a dosage taken by the Idol. This model does not have Manifestation and is not summoned or Debound through the Legions of Excess rules.

Idol. The usual Stupefied penalties and next Command-phase recovery apply. The effect
remains if a recipient subsequently leaves the Idol's range.
Signature Elixir: Nectar of the Idol
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. If
Stupefied, those weapons also gain [CLEAVE 2].
Communion affects every friendly non-Daemon EC unit within range; it is not restricted to
Infantry and does not select only one recipient. It is a voluntary release by the Idol, but once
released all eligible units in its radius are affected.
The Idol dispenses the drug. It does not gain Nectar's benefits itself. Its healing aura and
self-heal remain separate abilities and do not require Nectar to be released.
Bound daemonic body
This model has the Daemon keyword and remains an Emperor's Children unit. It does not
have Combat Drugs and cannot take dosages itself. Its two permanent Warband Elixir
effects come only from Bound Excess. Communion of Excess administers Nectar to nearby
eligible units; it is not a dosage taken by the Idol. This model does not have Manifestation
and is not summoned or Debound through the Legions of Excess rules.

units.name: Chirurgeon
units.rules:
Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Composition: 1 Chirurgeon Equipment: Injector pistol, surgical implements, reductor

**Equipment options**

Replace the injector pistol with a bolt pistol, plasma pistol or screamer pistol.

Core: Support.

**Reconstructive Art**

At the start of your Command phase, this model's unit heals D3+1 wounds.

**Controlled Overdose**

Once per battle round, when this model's unit fails a dosage Leadership test, it can suffer 1 additional mortal wound (3 in total) instead of the normal 2. If it does, that failure does not make it Battle-shocked.

**Attachments**

Support: Tormentors, Infractors, Noise Marines, Flawless Blades or Fleshbound. One Leader and one Support may join the same bodyguard.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Chirurgeon, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

**Equipment options**

Core: Support.

**Procession of Sensation (Aura)**

Once per phase, when Pain Brings Clarity clears Battle-shock from a friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 6" of this model, if that unit is unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

For this model's unit, the enemy-failed-Battle-shock trigger of Pain Brings Clarity has a range of 8" instead of 6". The unit-destroyed trigger retains its normal 6" range.

Support: Tormentors, Infractors, Noise Marines, Flawless Blades, Fleshbound or Ecstatic Congregation.

units.name: Sibyl of Excess
units.rules:
Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Composition: 1 Sibyl of Excess Equipment: Rapturestorm, sibylline staff

Core: Leader.

**Psyker Level 3**

Use powers with a combined level of up to 3 per battle round. Each requires this unit not to be Battle-shocked. Roll a D6: on 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked; the power still resolves.

**Sacrificial Chorus**

Once per battle round, when this model rolls a 1 for a psychic roll, destroy one friendly Chained Thrall model within 6" of this model to prevent the resulting Battle-shock.

**Borrowed Senses (Psychic Level 1)**

In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one visible friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 18". Until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons have +6" Range and Ignores Cover.

**Veil of the Unreal (Psychic Level 2)**

At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one visible friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 12". Until the end of the phase, enemies can only target that unit with ranged attacks from within 12".

**Grand Masquerade (Psychic Level 3)**

In your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select up to two friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry units within 12" that are unengaged. Remove them and set them up anywhere on the battlefield more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. They count as having made a Normal move and cannot move again that phase.

**Attachments**

Leader: Ecstatic Congregation, Chained Thralls or Fleshbound.

Keywords: Infantry, Character, Psyker, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

units.name: Keeper of Secrets
units.rules:
Core: Damaged 6, Deadly Demise D6. Army rules: Manifestation. Psyker Level: 3.

Composition: 1 Keeper of Secrets. Equipment: Phantasmagoria, Living whip, Witstealer sword, Snapping claws, Ritual knife.

**Equipment options**

Phantasmagoria, witstealer sword and snapping claws are standard. Select one additional option: living whip, ritual knife or shining aegis. A shining aegis improves its Save to 3+. Select one Phantasmagoria profile when shooting.

**Mesmerising Form**

Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks targeting this model.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Greater Daemonic Ritual; sacrifice required. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 6. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

Keywords: Monster, Character, Chaos, Daemon, Summoned, Slaanesh, Keeper of Secrets, Greater Daemon, Psyker. Faction: Legions of Excess.

CHARACTER / LEGIONS OF EXCESS / ABILITIES

Keeper of Secrets / Continued

**Reality Unravels - 12 inch Aura**

While a unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1; otherwise, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1. This affects friendly and enemy units alike. Multiple instances of Reality Unravels do not stack.

**Palace of Sensation - 6 inch Aura**

At the start of either Fight phase, every non-Daemon unit within 6" must take a Battle-shock test. Friendly and enemy units are affected. Each Keeper resolves its own aura.

**Acquiescence (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of your opponent's Charge phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one visible enemy unit within 18". Subtract 2 from its Charge rolls until the end of the phase.

**Pavane of Ecstasy (Psychic Level 2)**

At the start of your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 12" that is unengaged. It can immediately make a Normal move of up to 6".

**Rapturous Dominion (Psychic Level 3)**

At the start of your Command phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select up to two friendly Legions of Excess units within 6". Each gains 1 Manifestation point, subject to its maximum and the limit of gaining 1 point per phase.

Core: Infiltrators.

**Objective Defiled**

At the end of your Command phase, each objective marker you control that this unit is within range of becomes secured.

**Icon of Excess**

After this unit has shot or fought, if its attacks destroyed one or more enemy units and it is not already Stupefied, it can become Stupefied, selecting one accessible elixir and ignoring its activation timing. No dosage test is taken; normal Stupefied recovery applies.

Keywords: Infantry, Battleline, Explosives, Tormentors, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

**Eligible attachments**

Leader: Lord Exultant, Raptureweaver, Torment Oracle. Support: Chirurgeon, Herald of Excess.

Composition: 1 Alluress and 9 Daemonettes. Equipment: Slashing claws.

**Equipment options**

One Daemonette can carry a daemonic icon and a different Daemonette can carry an instrument of Chaos.

**Horrifying Beauty**

At the start of either Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with this ability must take a Battle-shock test. Subtract 1 if it is Below Half-strength. A unit takes only one test through this ability per phase.

**Daemonic Icon**

Each time this unit is summoned, you can re-roll its initial Manifestation roll.

**Instrument of Chaos**

Add 1 to this unit's Charge rolls.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Lesser Daemonic Ritual. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

Faction: Legions of Excess.

**Eligible attachments**

Leader: Syll'Esske, Tranceweaver, Infernal Enrapturess, Contorted Epitome.

units.rules:
Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Composition: 3 or 6 Flawless Blades Equipment: Each: blissblade and bolt pistol.

**Equipment options**

None.

Core: None.

**Daemonic Patrons**

When selected to fight, this unit can invoke its patrons: unmodified Wound rolls of 3+ are Critical Wounds for its attacks that phase. If it invokes them but destroys no enemy models with its attacks that phase, destroy one model in this unit at the end of the phase.

**Signature Elixir: Mirrorblood Distillate**

Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until its end. Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save. If Stupefied, each unmodified saving throw of 6 against a melee attack inflicts 1 mortal wound on the attacking unit after it finishes making its attacks, to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per phase.

Keywords: Infantry, Explosives, Flawless Blades, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

**Eligible attachments**

Leader: Lucius the Eternal, Eidolon, Torment Oracle. Support: Chirurgeon, Herald of Excess.

Composition: 3 Phoenix Guard Terminators; maximum 3 Equipment: Each: Phoenix power spear.

Core: Deep Strike.

**Gilded Retinue**

While a Character leads this unit, attacks targeting this unit cannot have Precision.

**Sublime Intervention**

Once per battle round, when you target this unit with Heroic Intervention, reduce that use's CP cost by 1.

**Retinue of the Phoenician**

When mustering your army, this unit can attach to Fulgrim as his Bodyguard instead of attaching another Character. While attached, Phoenix Guard models have +6" Move and lose Infantry; every model in the attached unit has Mobile. Fulgrim's permanent elixirs remain personal to him.

**Signature Elixir: Aureate Vitae**

Activate at the start of either Charge phase; lasts until the end of the turn. Re-roll Charge rolls for this unit. If Stupefied, this unit also has Fights First.

**Attachments**

Leader: Lucius or Lord Exultant in Terminator Armour; alternatively attach to Fulgrim using Retinue of the Phoenician.

Keywords: Infantry, Terminator, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

Friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry units wholly within 3" of this unit have the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

**Cut and Depart**

Composition: 1 Mirrorblade Exemplar and 4 or 9 Mirror Guard. Equipment: Shardglass blades.

**Stolen Reflection**

At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill of melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit by 1. Multiple instances do not stack.

**Through the Looking Glass**

When making Pile-in or Consolidation moves, models in this unit can move through other models. They cannot end overlapping another model's base. All other restrictions on those moves apply.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Lesser Daemonic Ritual. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

units.name: Furies of Slaanesh
units.rules:
Core: Stealth. Army rules: Manifestation.

Composition: 5 or 10 Furies. Equipment: Hooked claws.

**Scattering Shadows**

Once per turn, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8", if this unit is unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 12".

**Fluttering Retreat**

At the end of either player's Fight phase, this unit can make a Fall Back move if engaged, or a Normal move of up to 12" if unengaged.

**Collectors of Sensation**

Each time this unit destroys an enemy model, select one model in this unit. Increase that model's OC by 1, to a maximum of 3, until the end of the battle. These increases persist through becoming Debound and being summoned again.

**Insignificant Manifestations**

Non-Daemon and Daemon Psykers can summon this unit. It loses Manifestation only at the end of your Fight phase, instead of at the end of every phase in your turn. Initial D3, maximum 3 and normal gain restrictions still apply.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Lesser Daemonic Ritual; non-Daemon or Daemon Psyker. Initial D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 only at the end of your Fight phase.

Keywords: Infantry, Fly, Chaos, Daemon, Summoned, Slaanesh, Furies of Slaanesh.

Faction: Legions of Excess.

units.rules:
Core: None. Army rules: Manifestation. Psyker Level: 1.

Composition: 1 Cantor and 2 Choristers. Equipment: Unmaking chorus, Talons of discord.

**Equipment options**

Each model selects one chorus profile when shooting. The unit is Psyker Level 1, not each model separately.

**Discordant Revelation**

After this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made with its Unmaking chorus. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

**Unending Refrain (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of a phase in your turn, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one other friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6". It does not lose a Manifestation point through its army rule at the end of the phase. This unit can use this power only once per turn. Preserving a point does not consume the recipient's point-gain allowance.

**Summoning and Manifestation**

Lesser Daemonic Ritual. Initial Manifestation: D3; maximum 3. Lose 1 at the end of every phase in your turn, except where a datasheet says otherwise.

Faction: Legions of Excess.

**Eligible attachments**

Leader: Infernal Enrapturess, Contorted Epitome.

units.rules:
Army rules: Combat Drugs.

Composition: 1 Stage of Excess; crew and beasts form one model Equipment: Grand vox array, performer blades, parade-beast limbs.

Core: Deadly Demise D3.

**Grand Performance**

At the start of your Command phase, select up to three friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children units within 12". Until the start of your next Command phase, each selected unit can once, at the start of any phase, activate one Warband Elixir without a dosage test and ignoring activation timing. It must otherwise be eligible; the normal duration applies. Leaving range does not remove this permission.

Defiler / Abilities

**Equipment options**

Replace main cannon with ectoplasma destructor or Defiler blastmaster. Replace two excruciator cannons with two magma cutters. After this unit has shot or fought, if its attacks destroyed one or more enemy units, select one friendly non-Daemon EC unit within 6". That unit resolves Pain Brings Clarity as though an enemy unit had been destroyed within 6" of it. This cannot clear Battle-shock while Stupefied.

Keywords: Vehicle, Walker, Daemon, Defiler, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.

Hades lascannon and heavy reaper autocannon each cost an additional 15 points per equipped weapon.

units.rules:

Composition: 1 Threnody Dreadnought Equipment: Cathedral sonic immolator, two heavy bolters, cathedral fist, crushing tread.

**Equipment options**

Replace two heavy bolters with two sonic blasters. Replace fist with twin lascannon or grand blastmaster. Crushing tread remains available. Select one profile for a multi-profile weapon.

Core: Damaged 8, Deadly Demise D6.

**Interred in Rapture**

At the start of the battle, select one accessible Combat Elixir. This model becomes Stupefied with it active and does not recover through normal Command-phase recovery. Other abilities can end or suspend this normally. Unless another effect prevents it, it becomes Stupefied again at the end of your next Command phase with the previous elixir. This never refreshes a once-per-battle use.

**This Ground Is My Stage**

At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker this model is within range of, whether or not you control it. Until the start of your next Command phase, while within range of that marker, this model cannot be Stupefied, retains its selected elixir's normal effects only and cannot activate additional elixirs. Ending Stupefied this way also clears its Battle-shock; ordinary subsequent Battle-shock is possible. If it leaves range, it immediately becomes Stupefied again unless another ability prevents this.

**Unending Refrain**

After this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made with its cathedral sonic immolator. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Keywords: Vehicle, Walker, Threnody Dreadnought, Chaos, Slaanesh. Faction: Emperor's Children.
