**1 DP**



**Allied allowance**

You can include up to 500 points of Legions of Excess. This allowance stacks with Ritual Host, permitting 1,000 points when both are selected. 

**Living Elixirs**

When mustering your army, select up to three Legions of Excess units from Keeper of Secrets, Tranceweaver, Infernal Enrapturess, Contorted Epitome, Fiends and Choir of Unmaking. Assign each selected unit one Warband Elixir. Living Elixir (6" Aura):  Friendly non-Daemon EC units within 6" gain that elixir's normal effect. No dosage test is taken and no Stupefied amplification is granted. Identical effects do not stack. The effect ends when the recipient leaves range or the source leaves the battlefield.

enhancements.name: Censer of Impossible Delights
enhancements.text: Legions of Excess Character with Living Elixir. Increase that aura's range to 8".

enhancements.name: Lingering Intoxication
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Character. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit would lose a Living Elixir effect because it leaves range or the source leaves the battlefield, retain one such elixir's normal effect until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Exhalation of Bliss
stratagems.text: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One friendly unit with Living Elixir. EFFECT: Replace its assigned elixir with another Warband Elixir until the end of the phase, then restore its original selection.

stratagems.name: Perfumed Veil
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets. TARGET: One friendly non-Daemon EC unit selected as a target and within a Living Elixir aura. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for ranged attacks targeting your unit.

stratagems.name: Follow the Fragrance
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Movement phase, after a friendly non-Daemon EC unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. TARGET: One unengaged friendly Living Elixir unit that was within 6" of that EC unit before the move. EFFECT: Your target can make a Normal move of up to 6", ending within 6" of that EC unit.

detachments.name: Ritual Host
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Allied allowance**

You can include up to 500 points of Legions of Excess. This allowance stacks with Perfumed Procession, permitting 1,000 points when both are selected. 

**A Thousand Willing Voices**

Non-Daemon EC Characters without Psyker can perform Lesser Daemonic Ritual as though they were Psyker Level 1, solely for that ritual. When a non-Daemon EC Psyker Character performs Lesser Daemonic Ritual, it does not consume that model's psychic-level allowance. Each summoner retains the normal one-ritual-per-turn limit. Greater Daemonic Ritual retains its Psyker and sacrifice requirements.

enhancements.name: Profane Conductor
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Character. When the bearer performs a summoning ritual, the summoned unit can be set up wholly within 8" of the bearer instead of 6".

enhancements.name: Consecrated Sacrificial Knife
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Psyker Character. Once per battle, when determining a Greater Daemon's initial Manifestation after the bearer summons it, roll two D3 and select one result.

stratagems.name: Summoning Circle
stratagems.text: WHEN: When a friendly non-Daemon EC Character begins a summoning ritual. TARGET: That Character and one other friendly non-Daemon EC Character within 6" that has not performed a ritual this turn. EFFECT: Both count as having performed a ritual this turn. Roll two D3 for initial Manifestation and select one result. This cannot combine with Consecrated Sacrificial Knife on the same roll. The performing Character must meet the chosen ritual's requirements.

stratagems.name: An Offering Nonetheless
stratagems.text: WHEN: When a friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit is destroyed by an enemy attack. TARGET: One friendly non-Daemon EC Psyker within 6" of that unit immediately before its last model was removed. EFFECT: Until the end of your next Charge phase, that Psyker can use the destroyed unit as the sacrifice for one Greater Daemonic Ritual. Perform that ritual at its normal timing.

stratagems.name: Blood Anchors
stratagems.text: WHEN: At the end of a phase in your turn, when a Legions of Excess unit would lose its final Manifestation point. TARGET: That friendly Legions unit and one friendly non-Daemon EC unit within 6". EFFECT: The EC unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. The Legions unit does not lose that point this phase. Preserving a point is not a Manifestation gain.

detachments.name: The Perfect Formula
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**An Expanded Apothecary**

Add Chronostim and Sovereign Delusion to your army's available Warband Elixirs. They are valid selections for abilities that select Warband Elixirs, including Bound Excess and Fulgrim's Master of Excess. 

**Warband Elixir: Chronostim**

Start of your Shooting phase; until its end. After this unit has shot, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" if unengaged.  If Stupefied,  that move can be up to 9" instead. A unit that makes this move cannot charge that turn. 

**Warband Elixir: Sovereign Delusion**

Start of either Command phase; until the end of the turn. Add 1 to models' OC.  If Stupefied,  Battle-shock does not set their OC to 0; use their modified OC instead.

enhancements.name: Alchemist's Chalice
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Character with Combat Drugs. Grants the bearer the personal elixir Kingsbane Distillate.

enhancements.name: Bloodglass Infusions [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Non-Character, non-Daemon EC Infantry unit with Combat Drugs. Grants that unit Glassvein Nectar.

stratagems.name: Measured Indulgence
stratagems.text: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One friendly EC unit with Combat Drugs. EFFECT: Your unit can activate one accessible elixir, ignoring its activation timing and taking its normal dosage test. An elixir normally lasting a phase lasts until the end of the current phase; one normally lasting a turn lasts until the end of the current turn.

stratagems.name: Measured Toxicity
stratagems.text: WHEN: Immediately before a friendly unit takes a dosage Leadership test. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: It suffers 2 mortal wounds and automatically passes that test.

stratagems.name: Metabolic Reserve
stratagems.text: WHEN: When a Warband Elixir activated by an ordinary dosage would expire. TARGET: The friendly unit benefiting from that elixir. EFFECT: That elixir instead lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

detachments.name: The Flesh Perfected
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Reconstructive Perfection**

When a Chirurgeon uses Reconstructive Art, select its own unit or another friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit within 6". That unit heals D3+3 wounds instead of D3+1. A unit can benefit from Reconstructive Art only once per phase. Use the restoration procedure in the weapon and psychic reference.

enhancements.name: Master of Reconstruction
enhancements.text: Chirurgeon. The bearer's Reconstructive Art restores 6 wounds instead of D3+3.

enhancements.name: Reanimator's Vial
enhancements.text: Chirurgeon. Once per battle, at the end of either Fight phase, one friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit within 6" heals D3+3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Emergency Sutures
stratagems.text: WHEN: After an enemy unit finishes making its attacks. TARGET: One surviving friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit that lost wounds to those attacks and is within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon. EFFECT: Your unit heals D3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Clinical Preparation
stratagems.text: WHEN: Immediately before a friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon takes a dosage Leadership test or Battle-shock test. TARGET: That Infantry unit. EFFECT: It automatically passes that test.

stratagems.name: Recovery Detail
stratagems.text: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon. EFFECT: It can make a Normal move of up to 6", ending within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon.

detachments.name: The Harmonic Cabal
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Resonant Minds**

Once per battle round, each friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker unit can use one Level 1 psychic power without consuming its psychic-level allowance. The power's normal procedure applies. This does not itself grant allied access.

enhancements.name: Mnemonic Pearl
enhancements.text: EC or Legions of Excess Psyker Character. Once per battle round, re-roll one psychic power roll made for the bearer.

enhancements.name: Voice Beyond the Veil
enhancements.text: EC or Legions of Excess Psyker Character. Add 6" to the Range of the bearer's Psychic ranged weapons and to the target-selection ranges of its non-summoning psychic powers. Powers affecting only the caster or its own unit retain their normal recipients.

stratagems.name: Psychic Concordance
stratagems.text: WHEN: When a friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker uses a non-summoning psychic power. TARGET: That Psyker and another friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker within 6". EFFECT: Measure the power's target range and visibility from the second Psyker. The original caster uses the power, rolls and spends its allowance. Powers restricted to the caster or its own unit retain those recipients.

stratagems.name: Warp Ward
stratagems.text: WHEN: After an enemy unit selects targets for a Psychic weapon. TARGET: One friendly EC or Legions of Excess unit selected as a target and within 6" of a friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Focused Malice
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, its Psychic ranged weapons gain Ignores Cover and improve their AP by 1.

detachments.name: Rapid Evisceration
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Arrive in Splendour**

Add 2" to the Move of friendly EC Transport models. Each time a friendly EC Infantry unit disembarks from a Transport, add 1 to its Charge rolls until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Master of the Grand Entrance
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Infantry Character. During a turn in which the bearer's unit disembarked from a Transport, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks.

enhancements.name: Expanded Processional Hold [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: EC Transport. Increase its transport capacity by two spaces. Existing model restrictions and space requirements apply.

stratagems.name: Violent Disembarkation
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly EC Infantry unit embarked within a Transport that made a Normal move this phase is selected to make a disembark move. TARGET: That embarked EC Infantry unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an assault disembark move instead of a disembark move.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Reception
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EC Infantry unit that disembarked this turn is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the AP of its ranged attacks targeting enemies within 12" by 1.

stratagems.name: Back Into the Limelight
stratagems.text: WHEN: End of either Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly EC Infantry unit wholly within 3" of a friendly EC Transport. EFFECT: It can immediately embark within that Transport.

detachments.name: Carnival of Engines
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Witness the Spectacle**

When a friendly EC Daemon Vehicle resolves Exultation in Ruin, it can select up to two eligible friendly units instead of one.

enhancements.name: Perfumed Furnace [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: EC Daemon Vehicle. Its Exultation in Ruin has a range of 8" instead of 6".

enhancements.name: Awakening Chimes [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Threnody Dreadnought. Once per battle, at the start of a phase, suspend Interred in Rapture and Stupefied until the end of that phase and clear its Battle-shock. It retains its selected elixir's normal effect and cannot take new dosages. Resume its previous state afterwards unless another ability prevents it. No use is refreshed.

stratagems.name: Feed the Furnace
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EC Daemon Vehicle, Agoniser or Threnody Dreadnought is selected to shoot or fight. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks targeting Battle-shocked units.

stratagems.name: Revel in the Wreckage
stratagems.text: WHEN: After a friendly EC Daemon Vehicle, Agoniser or Threnody Dreadnought destroys an enemy unit with its attacks. TARGET: That attacking unit. EFFECT: Its model heals D3+3 wounds.

stratagems.name: A Last Catastrophe
stratagems.text: WHEN: When a friendly EC Vehicle with Deadly Demise is destroyed, before rolling for that ability. TARGET: That Vehicle unit. You can use this Stratagem on it even though it has just been destroyed. EFFECT: Its Deadly Demise triggers on a 4+ instead of its normal result.

detachments.name: Cult of Perfect Agony
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Their Suffering, Our Apotheosis**

For this detachment,  Devotees  means Ecstatic Congregation, Chained Thralls and Fleshbound units. Once per turn, after a friendly Devotees unit is destroyed, select one friendly non-Daemon EC unit with Combat Drugs within 6" of that unit immediately before its last model was removed. The selected unit can activate one accessible elixir, ignoring its activation timing and taking its normal dosage test. An elixir normally lasting a phase lasts until the end of the current phase; one normally lasting a turn lasts until the end of the current turn.

enhancements.name: Beloved of the Congregation
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Character. While the bearer leads a Devotees unit, add 1 to the OC of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Rapt Congregation [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Devotees unit. Models in that unit have Feel No Pain 6+.

stratagems.name: The Crowd Surges
stratagems.text: WHEN: Start of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Devotees unit within 6" of a friendly non-Daemon EC Character. EFFECT: Add 2" to its Move until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Bodies for Beauty
stratagems.text: WHEN: After an enemy unit selects targets in the Shooting or Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit selected as a target and one friendly Devotees unit within 6" of it. EFFECT: The Devotees unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Until that enemy unit finishes attacking, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks targeting the protected unit.

stratagems.name: Devotion Undiminished
stratagems.text: WHEN: After an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One surviving friendly Devotees unit that lost one or more models to those attacks. EFFECT: It can make a Normal move of up to 6", ending closer to the attacking unit.

detachments.name: The Veiled Hunt
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**The Hunt Begins Before the Battle**

Before deployment, select up to three non-Daemon EC Infantry units, excluding Terminator and Jump Pack units. Models in those units gain Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Quicksilver Mantle
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Infantry Character, excluding Terminators. Add 2" to the Move of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Vanishing Refrain [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Ghosts unit. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is unengaged and more than 6" from all enemy units, place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Slip the Noose
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of a friendly Ghosts or Gilded Knife unit. TARGET: That unengaged friendly unit. EFFECT: It can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Death in the Mist
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ghosts or Gilded Knife unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons gain Precision and improve their AP by 1.

stratagems.name: Another False Reflection
stratagems.text: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Ghosts or Gilded Knife unit that is unengaged and more than 6" from all enemy units. EFFECT: Remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. It cannot charge this turn.

detachments.name: The Gilded Retinue
detachments.rules:
**1 DP**



**Peerless Technique**

At the start of each Fight phase, each friendly Excruciator Terminator, Phoenix Guard Terminator and Flawless Blade unit can select one technique until the end of the phase: The Killing Stroke:  Improve the AP of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. The Perfect Guard:  Each time a melee attack targets this unit, worsen that attack's AP by 1.

enhancements.name: Gilded Command
enhancements.text: Lord Exultant in Terminator Armour. Once per battle round, when you target the bearer's unit with a stratagem from this detachment, reduce that use's CP cost by 1.

enhancements.name: Auric Panoply [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Excruciator Terminators or Phoenix Guard Terminators. Once per battle, when an enemy unit selects this unit as a target, subtract 1 from the Damage of attacks targeting it until that enemy unit finishes attacking, to a minimum of 1.

stratagems.name: Sovereign Footing
stratagems.text: WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly Excruciator Terminator, Phoenix Guard Terminator or Flawless Blade unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls for charges targeting your unit.

stratagems.name: Pierce the Pretender
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Excruciator Terminator, Phoenix Guard Terminator or Flawless Blade unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, its melee weapons gain Precision.

stratagems.name: A Perfect Landing
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Movement phase, immediately after a friendly Excruciator Terminator or Phoenix Guard Terminator unit makes an ingress move using Deep Strike. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Add 1 to its Charge rolls until the end of the turn.

detachments.name: Kakophonic Conclave
detachments.rules:
**2 DP**

**Overwhelming Resonance**

Each time an EC model makes a ranged attack targeting an enemy unit within 12" of that model, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack and improve its Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

enhancements.name: Conductor's Baton
enhancements.text: Lord Kakophonist. After the bearer's unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit. Subtract 1 from that enemy unit's Leadership and Battle-shock tests until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Perfect Pitch
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon EC Infantry Character. When models in the bearer's unit make ranged attacks, you can ignore modifiers to their BS characteristics and Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Resonance Baffles [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Noise Marines, Dissonant Colossi or Threnody Dreadnought. Add 3" to the Range of this unit's ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Cathedral Amplifier [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: EC Vehicle. Once per battle, when selected to shoot, select one ranged weapon equipped by this model. Add 2 to its Attacks until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Focused Rupture
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EC unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for its ranged attacks targeting Monster or Vehicle units.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Discord
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an engaged friendly EC Infantry or Walker unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Its ranged weapons gain Close-Quarters until the end of the phase. Weapons with Blast lose that ability and gain 1 Attack for the same duration.

stratagems.name: Drowning Crescendo
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly EC unit finishes shooting. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: Echoing Annihilation
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly EC unit destroys an enemy unit with its attacks. TARGET: That attacking unit. EFFECT: Select another enemy unit that was within 6" of the destroyed unit immediately before its last model was removed. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Feedback Reprisal
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One surviving friendly Noise Marines or Dissonant Colossi unit that lost one or more models to those attacks. EFFECT: Your unit can shoot using normal shooting, targeting only that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Discordant Veil
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets. TARGET: One friendly EC Infantry unit selected as a target. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for ranged attacks targeting your unit.

detachments.name: Peerless Bladesmen
detachments.rules:
**2 DP**



**Exquisite Swordsmanship**

Each time an EC unit, excluding Vehicles, is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one fighting form for that unit until the end of the phase. Each unit chooses independently. The Duellist:  Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain Precision. The Executioner:  Add 1 to the Damage of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. The Coiling Serpent:  Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6". It does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. Other requirements of that move still apply.

enhancements.name: Master of Exquisite Swordsmanship
enhancements.text: EC Character, excluding Vehicles. Once per battle round, when the bearer's unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one additional fighting form for that unit until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: The Paragon's Edge
enhancements.text: EC Character. Select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer. Add 1 to its Damage.

enhancements.name: Bloodless Elegance
enhancements.text: EC Character. After the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit with melee attacks, the bearer heals 3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Exquisite Balance [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Infractors, Flawless Blades, Excruciator Terminators or Phoenix Guard Terminators. Re-roll Charge rolls for this unit.

stratagems.name: Unerring Lunge
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Charge phase, before a friendly EC unit makes a Charge roll. TARGET: That unit, excluding Vehicles. EFFECT: Add 2 to that Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Faultless Parry
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets. TARGET: One friendly EC unit selected as a target, excluding Vehicles. EFFECT: Until that enemy unit finishes attacking, subtract 1 from the Damage of melee attacks targeting your unit, to a minimum of 1.

stratagems.name: Cut Out the Heart
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly EC unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That unit, excluding Vehicles. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for its melee attacks targeting Character units.

stratagems.name: Cut Down the Weak
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, immediately after an enemy unit makes a Fall Back move. TARGET: One friendly EC unit within 6" of that enemy unit that would be eligible to charge it if it were your Charge phase. Vehicles can only be selected if they are Walkers. EFFECT: Your unit can declare a charge, including that enemy unit among its charge targets. Your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Exploit the Opening
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase, after a friendly EC unit finishes fighting and destroyed an enemy unit with its attacks. TARGET: That unit, excluding Vehicles. EFFECT: If your unit is unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Flawless Execution
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly EC unit is selected to fight. TARGET: One friendly Infractors, Flawless Blades, Excruciator Terminators or Phoenix Guard Terminators unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

detachments.name: Mercurial Host
detachments.rules:
**2 DP**



**Never Still**

For this detachment,  Mercurial units  means friendly EC Infantry, Mounted and Beast units. Add 2" to the Move of models in Mercurial units. Once per turn, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of an unengaged Mercurial unit, one such friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Master of the Chase
enhancements.text: EC Infantry or Mounted Character. Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Silken Escape
enhancements.text: EC Infantry Character. When the bearer's unit Falls Back, its models can move through enemy Infantry models and their Engagement Range. Automatically pass Desperate Escape tests for that move.

enhancements.name: The Hunt Unfolds
enhancements.text: EC Infantry Character. Models in the bearer's unit gain Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Bounding Excess [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Howling Cavaliers or Rapture Talons. Once per battle round, when this unit is selected to make an Advance move, you can change its Advance roll to a 6.

stratagems.name: Slip Beyond Reach
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. TARGET: One engaged Mercurial unit within 8" of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Cruel Momentum
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Charge phase, after a Mercurial unit ends a Charge move. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit and roll six D6. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: A Change of Partners
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Movement phase, after a Mercurial unit finishes a Fall Back move. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: It can immediately make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Surging Pursuit
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit finishes a Fall Back move. TARGET: One unengaged Mercurial unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", ending closer to that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Running Battle
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a Mercurial unit finishes shooting. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: If unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: The Vanishing Procession
stratagems.text: WHEN: End of your opponent's turn. TARGET: One unengaged Mercurial unit. EFFECT: Place your unit into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Coterie of the Conceited
detachments.rules:
3 DP  / Priority Assets or Purge the Foe 

**Pledges to the Dark Prince**

At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds. EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle (these are all cumulative): 1+ Pact: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 3+ Pact: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. 5+ Pact: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] abilities. 7+ Pact: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. if that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and unengaged, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Once per turn, after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

stratagems.name: Protection of the Dark Prince
stratagems.text: WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army. TARGET: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Unshakeable Opponents
stratagems.text: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Embrace the Pain
stratagems.text: WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

stratagems.name: Martial Perfection
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase. TARGET: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Unbound Arrogance
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit. TARGET: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit. EFFECT: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1. Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Armour of Abhorrence
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.name: Carnival of Excess
detachments.rules:
2 DP  / Disruption or Priority Assets 

**Allied allowance**

You can include Legions of Excess allies up to 500 points at Incursion, 1,000 points at Strike Force or 1,500 points at Onslaught. Legions models cannot be your Warlord. 

**Daemonic Empowerment**

An EC unit within 6" of one or more friendly Legions of Excess units is  Empowered . A Legions of Excess unit within 6" of one or more friendly EC units is Empowered. EC units:  While Empowered, add 1 to this unit's dosage Leadership tests. If it activates its first ordinary Combat Elixir dose of the turn while Empowered, it heals D3 wounds after resolving the dosage test and its consequences. This restoration occurs once per unit per turn. Becoming Stupefied does not trigger it. Legions units:  While Empowered, add 1 to this unit's Advance and Charge rolls. Mortal Anchors:  Each time a Legions unit is summoned, if it is Empowered at the end of that phase, it does not lose a Manifestation point at that phase's end. Afterwards, its normal losses resume.

enhancements.name: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.text: EC Character. Once per battle round, when a friendly Slaanesh unit within 6" of the bearer is targeted with Heroic Intervention, reduce that use's CP cost by 1.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings
enhancements.text: EC Infantry Character. Once per battle, after an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target, the bearer gains a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Possessed Blade
enhancements.text: EC Character. Select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer and add 1 to its Attacks. Each time the bearer is selected to fight, you can empower that weapon for those attacks: add 1 to its Damage and it gains Devastating Wounds and Hazardous.

enhancements.name: Warp Walker
enhancements.text: EC Character or Keeper of Secrets. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to make an Advance move, change its Advance roll to a 6. During Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves, its models can move through enemy models and their Engagement Range, but cannot end within Engagement Range. Automatically pass Desperate Escape tests for those moves.

stratagems.name: Sustained by Agony
stratagems.text: WHEN: Either Fight phase, after a friendly EC unit destroys an enemy unit. TARGET: That attacking EC unit. EFFECT: Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6". That Legions unit heals D3+3 wounds, using the normal restoration procedure, including eligible returned models. This does not grant Manifestation points.

stratagems.name: Ecstatic Slaughter
stratagems.text: WHEN: Either Fight phase, after a friendly Legions of Excess unit destroys an enemy unit. TARGET: That Legions unit and one unengaged friendly EC unit within 6" of it. EFFECT: The EC unit can declare a charge. If it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.

stratagems.name: Violent Crescendo
stratagems.text: WHEN: Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly Slaanesh Infantry, Mounted or Beast unit that has not been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6". It does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. Other requirements of that move still apply.

stratagems.name: Sycophantic Surge
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly Legions of Excess unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, it can declare a charge after Advancing or Falling Back, provided at least one charge target is engaged with a friendly EC unit.

stratagems.name: Uncanny Reactions
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets. TARGET: One friendly Slaanesh unit selected as a target. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks targeting your unit.

stratagems.name: Dark Apparitions
stratagems.text: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly Legions of Excess unit, excluding Greater Daemons. EFFECT: Your unit becomes Debound. The next time it is summoned, it can be set up more than 6" horizontally from enemy models instead of 8". Use the normal summoner, ritual and initial Manifestation procedure; retain surviving models and wounds.

detachments.name: The Grand Symphony
detachments.rules:
3DP / DETACHMENT RULE




The Grand Symphony
The Emperor's Children make war as a performance, amassing Stage Tokens through sonic violence before
spending them on escalating rewards.



  3 DP / THE GRAND SYMPHONY
  One 3DP selection. No other detachment can be selected at Strike Force.


Instruments of Excess

SONIC is an equipment-derived UNIT keyword. A friendly Emperor's Children unit containing at least
one model equipped with a weapon from the Sonic Weapons register (page 136) gains SONIC. If no
such model remains, it loses SONIC. SONIC is not a weapon keyword, and weapons not listed do not
become Sonic Weapons merely because their unit has SONIC.

Attached units count the equipment of their combined models. Determine eligibility from equipment
actually taken when mustering, not from every option printed on a datasheet. This keyword rule
applies throughout this codex; the Grand Symphony is the detachment that spends Stage Tokens.

Stage Tokens - building the performance

Starting pool: 0 Stage Tokens. Unspent tokens carry between rounds. Your pool cannot exceed 12
Stage Tokens; you can gain at most 6 in each battle round. Tokens are not CP, do not interact with
Stratagem cost rules, and are not gained by Legions of Excess units.

Damage verse: After a friendly EC unit finishes shooting in your Shooting phase, if one or more attacks
made by that unit with a listed Sonic Weapon caused an enemy model to lose one or more wounds,
gain 1 Stage Token. A unit can generate this reward only once per Shooting phase, no matter how
many weapons hit or how much damage it dealt.

Slaughter verse: Once per Shooting phase, after a friendly EC SONIC unit destroys an enemy unit with
a ranged attack made with a listed Sonic Weapon, gain 1 additional Stage Token. Resolve these token
gains before checking whether you can pay for Daemonic Encore.

Trigger precision: A successful Wound roll that is saved does not count as damage. Any enemy unit
destroyed by an attack from a friendly SONIC unit can trigger Daemonic Encore, but only a listed Sonic
Weapon generates the extra Slaughter verse token.

Available performances

Spend your stored Stage Tokens on the performances on page 137 at their specified timing. You must
have enough tokens before paying. The same Stage Tokens cannot fund more than one performance.
+1 Damage bonuses from Shattering Crescendo and The Grand Finale do not stack on the same
attack.

3DP / PERFORMANCE COSTS




Spend Stage Tokens
Choose between disrupting enemy formations, intensifying gunfire or materialising daemons at the climax of a
slaughter.


Discordant Overture - 2 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly SONIC unit has shot and hit an enemy unit with a listed Sonic
Weapon. EFFECT: That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Resolve after that
attacking unit's shooting. Multiple Overtures cannot target the same unit in one phase.

Shattering Crescendo - 4 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when you select one friendly EC unit to shoot. REQUIREMENT: Select one enemy
unit that was already hit by a listed Sonic Weapon earlier in the phase. EFFECT: Until the end of this phase, add
1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged attacks made by the selected EC unit that target that enemy unit.
Once per Shooting phase.

Daemonic Encore - 7 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Immediately after a friendly EC SONIC unit destroys an enemy unit with one or more of its ranged
attacks. Mark the position of the last model removed from that destroyed enemy unit. EFFECT: Create and
summon one unit of ten Daemonettes without paying any army points, without a summoner, without a sacrifice
and without a summoning-pool declaration.

Set up the first Daemonette model as close as possible to the last removed model's position; set up the
remaining models as close as possible while keeping the unit in coherency. Models cannot overlap occupied
bases or be placed in impassable positions. Ignore the ordinary 8-inch enemy-distance requirement: these
Daemonettes may be set up within Engagement Range of enemy units. This permission overrides only that
setup restriction.

The unit begins with 3 Manifestation points (maximum 3) and does not lose a point at the end of the phase in
which it appears. Afterwards it uses the ordinary Manifestation rules. If it becomes Debound, remove it from the
battle rather than return it to the summoning pool. It can fight and, if eligible, charge normally under core rules.
If all ten models cannot be placed legally in coherency, the summon cannot be performed and no tokens are
spent.

No per-turn or per-battle summoning cap. You can repeat Daemonic Encore every time you meet its trigger and
can pay the tokens. These free Daemonettes do not grant access to paid Legions of Excess allies or additional
free datasheets.

The Grand Finale - 9 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase. EFFECT: Until the end of that phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of
ranged weapons equipped by models in friendly EC SONIC units when targeting enemy units within 12" of those
models. Once per battle. This bonus cannot stack with Shattering Crescendo on the same attack.

enhancements.name: Audience of One Thousand

stratagems.name: Precise Harmonics
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SONIC unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with listed Sonic Weapons until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Deafening Pressure
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly SONIC unit has shot. TARGET: One enemy unit hit by a listed Sonic Weapon from that unit. EFFECT: Subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from its Charge rolls until the start of your next Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: Wall of Noise
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, immediately after an enemy unit selects targets. TARGET: One friendly SONIC unit selected as a target. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished its attacks, worsen the AP of ranged attacks targeting your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Volume
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SONIC unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls made for its attacks with listed Sonic Weapons against Battle-shocked enemy units.

stratagems.name: Reverberating Terror
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly SONIC unit destroys an enemy unit with a ranged attack. TARGET: That SONIC unit. EFFECT: Select one other enemy unit within 6" of the last model removed from the destroyed unit. It must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: Measured Crescendo
stratagems.text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SONIC unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when that unit makes ranged attacks with listed Sonic Weapons, ignore modifiers to its Ballistic Skill characteristic and Hit rolls.

references.title: Mustering the host
references.text:
Choose Emperor's Children as your army faction. Select units from this book, appoint an eligible Character as Warlord, record unit sizes and equipment, choose detachments, assign enhancements and declare attachments when mustering. Fulgrim must be your Warlord if included. Battle size Army points DP Enhancements Copies / sheet Incursion 1,000 2 2 2 Strike Force 2,000 3 4 3 Battleline and Dedicated Transport copy limits are doubled. Each Epic Hero is limited to one. Use the core mission rules for battle sizes not listed here. At Incursion, a single 3DP detachment can be your only selection if the core rules permit it. 

**Detachments**

Spend no more than your DP allowance. Do not select a detachment more than once. Detachments sharing a Unique tag cannot be selected together. The fifteen packages grant their printed rules, enhancements and stratagems. Allied access is granted only by the three named daemon detachments, within their printed points allowances. 

**Enhancements**

Select enhancements only from chosen detachments and pay their listed points. Each normal enhancement is unique, is assigned to an eligible non-Epic Hero Character, and each unit can have only one enhancement. An enhancement tagged Upgrade can be given to the specified non-Character unit. Follow the core Upgrade rules for additional copies and the enhancement limit. 

**Leader and Support**

Declare attachments when mustering. One eligible Leader and one eligible Support can join the same Bodyguard unit. A Support must attach to an eligible unit. Use the attachment index at the back. Phoenix Guard attaching to Fulgrim is an explicit bespoke exception. 

**Record permanent choices**

Record the two Warband Elixirs selected for every model with Bound Excess and for Fulgrim through Master of Excess. Record the Threnody's starting elixir separately. Permanent benefits on a model do not automatically apply to other models in an Attached unit. Detachment rules and prices are the accepted current project values, subject to playtesting. The roster points are the current project values, with unchanged published chassis priced from the checked baseline where no custom replacement was established.

references.title: Combat Drugs
references.text:
**Combat Elixirs**

Combat Drugs includes dosages, Pain Brings Clarity and Stupefied. There are eight core Warband Elixirs; selected detachments can add further Warband choices. A Signature Elixir is accessible only where its datasheet or another ability grants access. A rule permitting one Combat Elixir from this codex can select Warband, Signature, detachment or enhancement elixirs, but cannot refresh an expended once-per-battle use. 

**Taking a dose**

At the start of a phase allowed by an accessible elixir, an eligible unit can activate it and take a Leadership test. Resolve the elixir whether the test passes or fails. On a failure, the unit suffers  2 mortal wounds , then becomes Battle-shocked, in that order. Wounds lost to the dosage do not themselves trigger Pain Brings Clarity. 

**Multiple doses**

A unit can activate several different accessible elixirs while eligible, taking a separate test for each. It cannot activate the same elixir again while that elixir is active; identical effects do not stack. Battle-shock prevents new ordinary doses but does not end existing effects. 

**Daemons and bound bodies**

Daemons do not take ordinary doses or become Stupefied unless specifically permitted. Bound Excess grants persistent normal benefits directly to its model. Daemon abilities can administer elixirs to eligible recipients without the Daemon consuming them. Fulgrim has his own exception. 

**Scope of benefits**

An ordinary dose affects the whole receiving unit, including attached models, except where its text names a particular model or weapon. Elixirs can modify only attacks or rolls that actually occur: Torrent has no Hit roll, and Advance-and-shoot permission does not remove unrelated restrictions. 

**Timing outside the normal phase**

An ability that grants an out-of-phase activation must say so. Becoming Stupefied ignores the selected elixir's activation window and extends it until recovery. Benefits still apply only to their specified actions: Hallucinogens prevents Movement-phase Overwatch; it does not create Charge-phase Overwatch.

references.title: Pain and Stupefied
references.text:
**Pain Brings Clarity**

A unit with Combat Drugs that is Battle-shocked but not Stupefied immediately ceases to be Battle-shocked when either of the following occurs: 1. A  friendly Emperor's Children unit or an enemy unit  within  6"  of it is destroyed. 2. An enemy unit within  6"  of it fails a Battle-shock test. For a unit being destroyed, measure the distance immediately before its last model is removed. Losing wounds or individual models does not trigger this rule. The receiving unit does not need to have caused the destruction. Its attacks destroying an enemy unit farther than 6" away do not ordinarily trigger this rule. Explicit abilities can grant additional ways to invoke it. 

**Become Stupefied**

At the  end of your Command phase , after earlier scoring, an eligible unit can become Stupefied. Choose one accessible Combat Elixir, ignoring its activation timing. It becomes Battle-shocked, ends all other elixir effects, and gains the chosen elixir's normal effect and its amplified Stupefied effect. No dosage test is taken for this choice. 

**While Stupefied**

The selected elixir lasts until recovery, overriding its normal duration. The unit cannot take new doses or ordinarily change its selected elixir. It automatically fails Leadership and Battle-shock tests and cannot cease to be Battle-shocked, including through Pain Brings Clarity. An explicit exception can override this. 

**Recovery**

In your next Command phase, at the normal Battle-shock step, automatically pass this unit's recovery test. Resolve this even if it would not otherwise need a test. This explicitly overrides automatic failure: Stupefied and its selected elixir end, and Battle-shock clears. The unit may become Stupefied again at the end of that phase. 

**Exceptions**

Fulgrim is not Battle-shocked while Stupefied. Lucius can suspend the state. The Threnody does not recover normally and has an objective-based lucidity ability. Bound Excess ordinarily prohibits Stupefied. These exceptions are described on their sheets.

references.title: Bound Excess
references.text:
**Bound Excess**

When mustering your army, select two different Warband Elixirs for this model. Their normal effects are always active for this model, ignoring activation timing and duration. It cannot activate additional Combat Elixirs or become Stupefied. If an effect requires an enemy selection, make that selection at the start of each applicable phase. Ordinary Battle-shock still applies. 

**Separate army rule**

Only units listing Bound Excess in their Army rules field have this rule. It is separate from Combat Drugs, Sublime Strategist and Manifestation. Ordinary recipients have two permanent normal effects, no personal dosages and no Stupefied. Fulgrim does not have Bound Excess; Master of Excess is his own datasheet ability. Recipients:  foot Daemon Prince, winged Daemon Prince, Julius Kaesoron, Doomrider, Idol of Sublime Perfection, Defiler, Maulerfiend, Heldrake and Cacophant. 

**Fulgrim: Master of Excess**

Fulgrim does not have this army rule. His separate Master of Excess datasheet ability grants his two permanent Warband Elixir selections and retains and amplifies both when he becomes Stupefied, alongside a third accessible elixir. Use his datasheet for Master of Excess and Sovereign of Sensation. 

**Exultation in Ruin**

After this unit has shot or fought, if its attacks destroyed one or more enemy units, select one friendly non-Daemon EC unit within 6". That unit resolves Pain Brings Clarity as though an enemy unit had been destroyed within 6" of it. This cannot clear Battle-shock while Stupefied. Recipients:  Defiler, Maulerfiend, Heldrake and Cacophant. Giving a Prince Bound Excess does not also give it Exultation in Ruin. 

**Personal permanent benefits**

Permanent selected effects apply to the model that has Bound Excess. They are not doses administered to its unit. Separately, Fulgrim's Master of Excess benefits are personal: his Phoenix Guard do not inherit the selections, and Stupefied affecting the Attached unit does not erase his explicit retained benefits. 

**Not bound engines**

The Agoniser and Threnody are interred mortal warriors, not Daemon models. They use Combat Drugs and their own datasheet exceptions. The Stage is non-Daemon Mounted, not a Vehicle. Chaos Spawn and Greater Chaos Spawn are non-Daemon Beasts in this roster. 

**Effects requiring selection**

A permanent Soporific Musk effect uses its normal defensive benefit. Its amplified enemy selection is unavailable to ordinary Bound Excess models, because they cannot become Stupefied. Fulgrim makes any amplified target selection at the start of the applicable Fight phase, or immediately if the effect is gained during that phase.

references.title: Sublime Strategist
references.text:
**Sublime Strategist**

At the start of the battle round, if a model with this army rule is your Warlord, gain 1CP. This army rule is separate from Combat Drugs. Only models whose datasheets list Sublime Strategist have it. It awards one CP at the start of each battle round if your Warlord qualifies; other eligible commanders do not each generate another CP. Eligible model Command role Fulgrim Epic Hero Eidolon Epic Hero Ramos Epic Hero Julius Kaesoron Epic Hero Lord Exultant Command Character Lord Exultant in Terminator Armour Command Character Lord Exultant with Jump Pack Command Character Lord Kakophonist Command Character Daemon Prince of Slaanesh Command Character Daemon Prince with Wings Command Character 

**Excluded models**

Lucius the Eternal and Doomrider do not have Sublime Strategist. Nor do the Raptureweaver, Torment Oracle, Sibyl, Chirurgeon, Herald, Gilded Knife or Idol. Choosing an excluded model as your Warlord does not grant this rule. 

**Interaction with drugs**

Ordinary Battle-shock or Stupefied does not turn off Sublime Strategist: its text does not require a dose, Leadership test or an un-Battle-shocked unit. Apply the core rules governing abilities of destroyed, embarked or off-battlefield models normally. This follows the commander-specific Warlord CP rule used in eleventh-edition codexes. It is not a CP refund, stratagem discount or reward for killing a unit.

references.title: Warband Elixirs
references.text:
**Hyperstimulants**

Activate:  start of your Movement phase.  Duration:  end of the turn. Ranged attacks made by this unit have Assault, and making an Advance move does not prevent this unit from declaring a charge that turn.  If Stupefied,  also add 2 to Advance rolls made for this unit. 

**Frenzon**

Activate:  start of your Movement phase.  Duration:  end of the turn. Making a Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from shooting or declaring a charge that turn.  If Stupefied,  also add 3" to the distance models in this unit can move when making a Fall Back move. 

**Adrenal Surge**

Activate:  start of either Fight phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.  If Stupefied,  Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6". It does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. Other requirements of that move still apply. 

**Razor's Edge**

Activate:  start of your Shooting phase or either Fight phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of this unit's attacks by 1.  If Stupefied, those attacks also have [LETHAL HITS].

references.title: Warband Elixirs / II
references.text:
**Soporific Musk**

Activate:  start of either Fight phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for melee attacks that target this unit.  If Stupefied,  select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this unit. That enemy unit loses Fights First until the end of the phase. 

**Hallucinogens**

Activate:  start of your Movement phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Enemy units cannot target this unit with attacks made using the Fire Overwatch Stratagem. If Stupefied,  moves made by this unit cannot trigger enemy abilities that allow reactive moves during that phase. 

**Heightened Senses**

Activate:  start of your Shooting phase or either Fight phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit.  If Stupefied,  each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 

**Euphoric Numbness**

Activate:  start of any phase.  Duration:  end of the phase. Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 5+.  If Stupefied,  each time a model in this unit is destroyed by an enemy attack in the Fight phase, if this unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield. It is removed after this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

references.title: Psychic and weapon reference
references.text:
**Psyker levels**

A Psyker can use abilities with a total level no greater than its Psyker Level each battle round. A power can be used no more than once per phase. Each listed power requires its caster's unit not to be Battle-shocked. Roll one D6: on 1 the unit becomes Battle-shocked, but resolve the power. This roll is not a Leadership or Battle-shock test. Psychic weapon attacks do not consume this budget unless specified. Psyker Level Role Raptureweaver 1 Defensive ward and reactive movement Torment Oracle 2 Battle-shock and forced movement Sibyl of Excess 3 Mortal protection and relocation Shalaxi Helbane 2 Hunting and terror Syll'Esske 2 Melee support and Manifestation Keeper of Secrets 3 Greater daemon support Tranceweaver 1 Daemonette support Contorted Epitome 3 Protection, terror and relocation Choir of Unmaking 1 Psychic infantry; level per unit 

**Current weapon conventions**

Flamers use fixed attacks with Blast. Sonic blasters and screamer pistols are Strength 6. The sonic combi-weapon profile remains Strength 5. All sonic ranged weapons have at least Blast 1; blastmasters have Blast 2. A specifically printed higher Blast value takes precedence. D6+1 Damage is replaced by D3+3; this is not a blanket replacement of all D6 rolls. 

**Blast X and Cleave X**

When all attacks with the weapon target one enemy unit, add X attack dice for each full five models in that target, using the core rule's counting step. Blast applies to ranged weapons; Cleave to melee weapons. Cleave does not spill damage between models. 

**Hunter profiles**

A profile labelled Hunter: Monster/Vehicle can target only Monster or Vehicle units. Its profile is an alternative, not an additional weapon. 

**Close-Quarters and Torrent**

Use Close-Quarters under the eleventh-edition shooting rules. Torrent automatically hits. Blast weapons remain subject to engagement restrictions unless an ability explicitly removes Blast or otherwise permits the attack. Eidolon's amplified Death Scream is one such exception. 

**Restoring wounds to a unit**

Heal a wounded model first. Excess restored wounds can return destroyed non-Character models and continue healing them, up to Starting Strength. Do not return a destroyed Character or an entirely destroyed unit unless an ability explicitly permits it. A single-model unit cannot exceed its starting wounds.

references.title: Eleventh-edition move reference
references.text:
**Disembark moves**

A disembarking unit is set up wholly within 3" of its Transport, following the core placement restrictions. A shock disembark move permits disembarking after that Transport Advances, but the passengers cannot declare a charge that turn. An assault disembark move permits the passengers to charge after their Transport makes a Normal move. Use the granting ability and all other core restrictions. 

**Ingress moves**

Ingress is the core move used to arrive from Reserves, including when using Deep Strike. Apply each unit's printed arrival distance. A rule that repositions a unit or summons a Legions of Excess unit does not become an ingress rule merely because it sets models up on the battlefield. 

**Normal shooting**

An out-of-phase rule specifying normal shooting uses the normal shooting procedure. It does not become Snap Shooting merely because it occurs outside your Shooting phase. Its printed target restrictions and other core restrictions still apply. 

**Damaged X**

While a model with Damaged X has X or fewer wounds remaining, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls. Fulgrim instead retains The Phoenician Prince, with its own threshold and modifiers. 

**Explosives and Close-Quarters**

Explosives is the current keyword used in place of Grenades on the affected datasheets. Close-Quarters is a weapon ability; a weapon named a pistol still uses its printed profile and abilities. 

**Conditional attack abilities**

A qualifier such as Lethal Hits: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE applies only when targeting units without either excluded keyword. An unqualified Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits ability retains its normal scope.

references.title: Legions of Excess
references.text:
**Separate faction**

Legions of Excess are allies, not Emperor's Children units. Choose Emperor's Children as your Army Faction. Your Warlord must be an eligible Emperor's Children model. Legions of Excess cannot be chosen as the Army Faction through this codex. 

**Exclusive detachment access**

Only Carnival of Excess (3DP), Perfumed Procession (1DP) and Ritual Host (1DP) permit Legions of Excess allies. Carnival permits 500/1,000/1,500 allied points at Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught. Perfumed Procession and Ritual Host each permit 500 points; their allowances stack to 1,000 when both are selected. Allies count toward normal army points and copy limits. 

**Bound EC daemons remain EC**

Fulgrim, Julius Kaesoron, Doomrider, the two Daemon Princes, the Idol and daemon engines remain Emperor's Children units. They do not require one of the three allied-access detachments and do not gain Manifestation. Their own listed army rules apply. 

**No personal drugs**

Legions of Excess units use Manifestation, not Combat Drugs or Bound Excess. Their Daemon keyword can make them eligible for a greater daemon aura regardless of army allegiance. A rule naming Emperor's Children does not automatically affect allied units. 

**Summoning pool**

When mustering, pay for the allied units and declare any legal attachments. These units begin in a summoning pool off the battlefield and enter through the rituals in this chapter. The pool is used for these rituals, not as an ordinary Deep Strike deployment or Strategic Reserves move. 

**Detachment benefits**

Use the full detachment entries for Living Elixir auras, expanded mortal ritual access, Daemonic Empowerment and Mortal Anchors. Their benefits do not change a unit's faction.

references.title: Manifestation
references.text:
**Arrival and maximum**

Each time a unit with this army rule is summoned, it gains D3 Manifestation points. Lesser daemons have a maximum of 3; Greater Daemons have a maximum of 6. A larger maximum does not change the initial D3 roll. 

**Feed on excess**

While this unit is on the battlefield, each time A UNIT within 6" of it is destroyed, or A UNIT within 6" of it fails a Battle-shock test, it gains 1 Manifestation point. Friendly and enemy units qualify, whether Daemons or non-Daemons. Measure a destroyed unit's range immediately before its last model is removed. 

**Gain cap**

A unit can gain at most 1 Manifestation point per phase, including points granted by psychic powers and other abilities, and cannot exceed its maximum. Gains can occur in either player's turn. Already being Battle-shocked grants nothing; an actual failed test is required. A required test automatically failed by a Stupefied unit can trigger this rule. 

**Instability**

At the end of each phase IN YOUR TURN, after resolving Manifestation gains for that phase, each unit with this army rule loses 1 point. If it has 0 points, it immediately becomes Debound. There is no ordinary point loss in your opponent's turn. Furies lose points only at the end of YOUR Fight phase. 

**Debound**

Remove the unit from the battlefield and return it to your summoning pool, retaining its surviving models and their remaining wounds. It can subsequently be summoned again. Becoming Debound is not being destroyed, but does trigger rules for leaving the battlefield. Resummoning does not restore models or wounds; roll initial Manifestation again. Persistent effects such as the Furies' collected OC remain in effect. 

**End-of-phase abilities**

A unit already removed as Debound cannot make a subsequent battlefield move. Resolve normal sequencing for simultaneous end-of-phase abilities; The Final Bow explicitly resolves before the Masque is removed.

references.title: Lesser daemon summoning
references.text:
**Lesser Daemonic Ritual (Psychic Level 1)**

At the start of a phase in your turn, one friendly non-Daemon Psyker whose unit is not Battle-shocked can use this power. Roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, its unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, resolve the following effect. Select one Legions of Excess unit in your summoning pool, excluding Greater Daemons. Set it up wholly within 6" of that Psyker and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. It gains D3 Manifestation points. No sacrifice is required. 

**Ritual limit and timing**

Each Psyker can perform one summoning ritual per turn. The lesser ritual uses 1 level of its normal psychic budget and follows this codex's psychic procedure. It does not bypass Battle-shock. A summoned unit loses a point at the end of its arrival phase normally. A summoned unit can declare a charge in your Charge phase if otherwise eligible, including when summoned at its start; summoning does not itself prohibit this. 

**Furies exception**

A friendly Daemon Psyker can also perform the lesser ritual, but can select only Furies of Slaanesh. This exception does not allow a Daemon Psyker to summon other lesser units or Greater Daemons. 

**Attached units**

Declare attachments when mustering. An eligible Leader and Bodyguard are summoned together as one Attached unit, using one ritual and one shared Manifestation roll and total while attached. The whole Attached unit must fit the setup restrictions and becomes Debound together. Retain its surviving models, wounds and attachment when it returns to the pool. Destroyed Leaders do not return unless an explicit ability permits it. 

**Lesser Epic Heroes**

The Masque and Syll'Esske use the lesser ritual and maximum of 3. Being an Epic Hero or Monster does not itself make a unit a Greater Daemon.

references.title: Greater daemon summoning
references.text:
**Greater Daemonic Ritual**

At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly non-Daemon Psyker that has not performed a summoning ritual this turn. Select one OTHER friendly non-Daemon Infantry unit within 6" of that Psyker to sacrifice. Destroy the sacrificed unit. Then select one Greater Daemon from your summoning pool and set it up wholly within 6" of the Psyker and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. It gains D3 Manifestation points and can declare a charge that phase. 

**Cost and sequence**

The ritual consumes that Psyker's summoning ritual for the turn and requires the sacrificed unit. It is not an additional levelled psychic power. Resolve the sacrifice and its destruction triggers before setting up the daemon. The arriving daemon cannot gain a point from its own sacrifice because it was not on the battlefield when that unit was destroyed. Daemons already nearby can gain normally. 

**Greater Daemons**

Shalaxi Helbane and Keepers of Secrets use this ritual and have a Manifestation maximum of 6. Each resummoning requires another ritual and sacrifice. Do not restore lost models or wounds through resummoning. Initial D3 Without additional gains or an exception 1 Debounds at the end of your Charge phase. 2 Can fight, then Debounds at the end of your Fight phase. 3 Survives your Fight phase with 1 point remaining. 

**Existing army interactions**

The sacrifice is a real destruction and can trigger other rules normally. Debinding is only leaving the battlefield; it is not a sacrifice or destruction.

references.title: Greater daemon auras
references.text:
**Reality Unravels - 12 inch Aura**

While a unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1; otherwise, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1. This affects friendly and enemy units alike. Multiple instances of Reality Unravels do not stack. Worsening Leadership means making its characteristic less favourable under the core rules. This is the oppressive effect on non-Daemons; it does not improve their chance of passing. The AP benefit also applies to enemy Daemons and to EC Daemon models such as the Idol, Princes and Fulgrim. 

**Keeper: Palace of Sensation - 6 inch Aura**

At the start of either Fight phase, every non-Daemon unit within 6" of the Keeper must take a Battle-shock test. Friendly and enemy units are affected. Each Keeper resolves its own aura. 

**Shalaxi: The Hunting Ground - 6 inch Aura**

Whenever any other unit within 6" of Shalaxi is selected to Fall Back, it must first take a Battle-shock test. If failed, it cannot Fall Back that phase. Friendly and enemy units, including Daemons, are affected. 

**Interaction with Manifestation**

Actual failed tests and units destroyed can feed nearby Manifestation normally. Apply the 1-point-per-phase gain cap. Do not grant points merely because a unit remains Battle-shocked. Reality Unravels never grants Combat Drugs or Bound Excess. 

**Distinct personal abilities**

The auras do not replace Shalaxi's quarry, The Hunt Sustains or psychic powers. Reality Unravels replaces the Keeper's former friendly-only melee AP aura; those two AP auras are not both present.

references.title: Sonic Weapons and SONIC Eligibility
references.text:
WEAPONS / EQUIPMENT REFERENCE




Sonic Weapons
This list defines equipment eligibility; the SONIC label belongs to the UNIT, not to an individual weapon profile.



  Weapon family                        Listed Sonic Weapons


  Handheld and sidearm                 Sonic blaster; twin sonic blaster; screamer pistol


  Combi-weapons                        Combi-weapon - sonic


  Blastmasters                         Blastmaster; dreadblastmaster


  Large blastmasters                   Grand blastmaster; cathedral blastmaster


  Defiler armory                       Defiler blastmaster; sonic balespewer


  Heavy sonic                          Sonic destructor; cathedral sonic immolator


  Resonance                            Resonance cannon


  Specialist weapons                   Shriek cannon; grand vox array


  Named weapons                        Death Scream; The Eighth's Refrain


For a weapon printed with multiple named firing profiles (for example, crescendo and rupture, or a focused
profile), each printed profile of that listed weapon counts. Weapon variants with the same listed base name
count. A generic weapon with the words "sonic" only in an ability description does not qualify unless listed here.

Practical equipment examples

Always SONIC with printed standard equipment: Noise Marines, Lord Kakophonist, Eidolon, Ramos, Dissonant
Colossi, Threnody Dreadnought and Stage of Excess.

SONIC when the listed option is taken: Cacophant (resonance cannon), Defiler (Defiler blastmaster or sonic
balespewer), Palatine Ravager (sonic destructor or sonic blasters), Chaos Land Raider (cathedral blastmasters
or twin sonic blaster), Chaos Rhino (sonic combi-weapon), Heldrake (sonic balespewer), Excruciator Terminators
(sonic combi-weapon or shriek cannon), and any other EC unit with an equipped weapon from the register.

Not Sonic Weapons in this edition: Ghost whisper carbines and the doomfire projector. These profiles can be
reconsidered separately; they do not qualify simply for thematic similarity.

What SONIC does, and does not, mean

Stage Token generation requires attacks made with listed Sonic Weapons, not attacks with any gun in a SONIC
unit. By contrast, Shattering Crescendo can enhance a selected EC unit's ranged attacks, and The Grand Finale
can enhance all ranged weapons carried by SONIC units as specifically printed on page 137.

references.title: Grand Symphony Performances
references.text:
3DP / PERFORMANCE COSTS




Spend Stage Tokens
Choose between disrupting enemy formations, intensifying gunfire or materialising daemons at the climax of a
slaughter.


Discordant Overture - 2 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly SONIC unit has shot and hit an enemy unit with a listed Sonic
Weapon. EFFECT: That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Resolve after that
attacking unit's shooting. Multiple Overtures cannot target the same unit in one phase.

Shattering Crescendo - 4 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when you select one friendly EC unit to shoot. REQUIREMENT: Select one enemy
unit that was already hit by a listed Sonic Weapon earlier in the phase. EFFECT: Until the end of this phase, add
1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged attacks made by the selected EC unit that target that enemy unit.
Once per Shooting phase.

Daemonic Encore - 7 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Immediately after a friendly EC SONIC unit destroys an enemy unit with one or more of its ranged
attacks. Mark the position of the last model removed from that destroyed enemy unit. EFFECT: Create and
summon one unit of ten Daemonettes without paying any army points, without a summoner, without a sacrifice
and without a summoning-pool declaration.

Set up the first Daemonette model as close as possible to the last removed model's position; set up the
remaining models as close as possible while keeping the unit in coherency. Models cannot overlap occupied
bases or be placed in impassable positions. Ignore the ordinary 8-inch enemy-distance requirement: these
Daemonettes may be set up within Engagement Range of enemy units. This permission overrides only that
setup restriction.

The unit begins with 3 Manifestation points (maximum 3) and does not lose a point at the end of the phase in
which it appears. Afterwards it uses the ordinary Manifestation rules. If it becomes Debound, remove it from the
battle rather than return it to the summoning pool. It can fight and, if eligible, charge normally under core rules.
If all ten models cannot be placed legally in coherency, the summon cannot be performed and no tokens are
spent.

No per-turn or per-battle summoning cap. You can repeat Daemonic Encore every time you meet its trigger and
can pay the tokens. These free Daemonettes do not grant access to paid Legions of Excess allies or additional
free datasheets.

The Grand Finale - 9 Stage Tokens

WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase. EFFECT: Until the end of that phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of
ranged weapons equipped by models in friendly EC SONIC units when targeting enemy units within 12" of those
models. Once per battle. This bonus cannot stack with Shattering Crescendo on the same attack.

RULES EDITION 3.1



Using this codex
This unofficial homebrew codex contains the current Emperor's Children roster and Combat
Drugs rules developed in this project. It is written for the eleventh-edition core rules and
agreed homebrew games. Use this book's datasheets and points together; later published
faction changes do not silently overwrite these profiles.
What is included
58 datasheets (45 EC and 13 allied Legions of Excess); eight Warband Elixirs; thirteen
Signature Elixirs; fifteen complete detachments (ten 1DP, three 2DP and two 3DP); points
and attachment indexes; optional Combat Patrol and campaign rules. Faction lore and
miniature galleries are omitted.
Established rules and new material
The army rule and roster consolidate the accepted conversation, with explicit later
corrections taking priority. The fifteen detachments incorporate the accepted conversation,
including all later corrections. Their enhancements and stratagems apply when you select
those packages. Optional play formats remain separate playtest material.
Scope
The Legions of Excess expansion is included as a separate allied faction with Manifestation.
EC Daemons retain their own faction and the army rules listed on their datasheets. Only
Carnival of Excess (3DP), Perfumed Procession (1DP) and Ritual Host (1DP) permit these
allies. Retired legacy unit sheets and Tormentbringer are excluded.
Reading a datasheet
Statistics apply per model unless an ability says otherwise. A weapon table lists every
available profile, not a permission to equip all options. Select equipment when mustering
your army. A multi-profile weapon fires or fights with one profile unless a rule explicitly
permits more. A model normally selects one melee weapon; Extra Attacks are additional.
Rules precedence
A specific datasheet exception overrides a shared restriction only where it says so.
Battle-shock and Stupefied are different conditions. Ignore Stupefied only when an ability
explicitly permits it; merely invoking Pain Brings Clarity cannot do so.
Notation: MW = mortal wounds; EC = Emperor's Children; CP = Command points; DP =
Detachment points. 5+++ means Feel No Pain 5+; 4++ means a 4+ invulnerable save.
Distances are inches.

ARMY CONSTRUCTION



Mustering the host
Choose Emperor's Children as your army faction. Select units from this book, appoint an
eligible Character as Warlord, record unit sizes and equipment, choose detachments, assign
enhancements and declare attachments when mustering. Fulgrim must be your Warlord if
included.

Battleline and Dedicated Transport copy limits are doubled. Each Epic Hero is limited to one.
Use the core mission rules for battle sizes not listed here. At Incursion, a single 3DP
detachment can be your only selection if the core rules permit it.
Detachments
Spend no more than your DP allowance. Do not select a detachment more than once.
Detachments sharing a Unique tag cannot be selected together. The fifteen packages grant
their printed rules, enhancements and stratagems. Allied access is granted only by the
three named daemon detachments, within their printed points allowances.
Enhancements
Select enhancements only from chosen detachments and pay their listed points. Each
normal enhancement is unique, is assigned to an eligible non-Epic Hero Character, and each
unit can have only one enhancement. An enhancement tagged Upgrade can be given to the
specified non-Character unit. Follow the core Upgrade rules for additional copies and the
enhancement limit.
Leader and Support
Declare attachments when mustering. One eligible Leader and one eligible Support can join
the same Bodyguard unit. A Support must attach to an eligible unit. Use the attachment
index at the back. Phoenix Guard attaching to Fulgrim is an explicit bespoke exception.
Record permanent choices
Record the two Warband Elixirs selected for every model with Bound Excess and for Fulgrim
through Master of Excess. Record the Threnody's starting elixir separately. Permanent
benefits on a model do not automatically apply to other models in an Attached unit.
Detachment rules and prices are the accepted current project values, subject to playtesting.
The roster points are the current project values, with unchanged published chassis priced
from the checked baseline where no custom replacement was established.
